exercises.q: What did Martin study at university?
exercises.text: Martin has worked as a nurse in a large hospital for six years. He didn't plan to become a nurse: at university he studied economics, but he hated sitting in an office all day. One evening, while he was visiting his grandmother in hospital, he talked to a nurse who was looking after her. She told him how much she enjoyed her job. A year later, Martin started a nursing course. Today he usually works night shifts, which he finds tiring, but he says he has never regretted his decision.

exercises.q: What did the family NOT have at the cottage?
exercises.text: When I was a teenager, my family used to spend every August in a small cottage in the mountains. There was no internet and the TV only had two channels, so we spent most of the day outside. My sister and I would go swimming in the lake or pick mushrooms in the forest. In the evenings, my dad would light a fire and tell us stories. The cottage was sold years ago, but I still think about those summers whenever I smell wood smoke.
